qa.title: Uneven lighting
qa.message: The background is much brighter in some corners than others (from 37 to 123 on a 0-255 brightness scale). The card's edges are harder to pick out in the brightest and the most shadowed parts.
qa.advice: Light the card evenly from all sides. Move the lamp further away, or bounce it off a wall or ceiling, and take the photo again.

qa.title: Only part of this edge could be measured
qa.message: The right border could only be measured along 44% of its length - the background was too plain to read against anywhere else. The number given describes that part of the border.
qa.advice: Use a plain background with a bit more contrast against the card, and light it evenly, so the whole edge stands out.

top.refusal_reason: The top edge of the card could not be measured: the readings along this edge did not agree with each other - they were spread over 110 pixels, which usually means a band of glare, or a background that changes too much along the edge.
top.refusal_advice: Re-shoot on plain white paper with soft light from all sides, so that every edge of the card stands out clearly.

bottom.refusal_reason: The bottom edge of the card could not be measured: the readings along this edge did not agree with each other - they were spread over 48 pixels, which usually means a band of glare, or a background that changes too much along the edge.
bottom.refusal_advice: Re-shoot on plain white paper with soft light from all sides, so that every edge of the card stands out clearly.

ratio_tb.refusal_reason: The top and bottom borders could not be measured, and both are needed for this. See below for why.
ratio_tb.refusal_advice: Re-shoot on plain white paper with soft light from all sides, so that every edge of the card stands out clearly.

qa.title: Uneven lighting
qa.message: The background is much brighter in some corners than others (from 15 to 87 on a 0-255 brightness scale). The parts of each edge that fall in the brightest or darkest areas were skipped.
qa.advice: Light the card evenly from all sides. Move the lamp further away, or bounce it off a wall or ceiling, and take the photo again.

qa.title: A known offset in the official picture was corrected
qa.message: The official card picture is cropped very slightly off-centre, by a known amount. That has been taken off the result (+0.00mm across, -0.08mm down), and the 0.10mm of doubt left over is included in the plus-or-minus figure.
qa.advice: Nothing to do. This correction is automatic and already included in the result.

result.shift_convention: positive x = print displaced toward right card edge; positive y = toward bottom edge
result.assumption: official render crop is layout-locked but NOT symmetric about print centre; a calibrated per-axis crop bias is subtracted from the raw shift (see GameSpec.render_crop_bias_mm). per_side_offsets_mm remain raw render-relative values, not absolute borders

y.refusal_reason: This cross-check needs the back's top border and the back's bottom border, which could not be measured. See the reasons above.

mirror_consistency: The back reads 54/46 left to right. The front works out to 45/55, which is 55.1/44.9 when you flip it over to compare. Both are looking at the same single cut, and they agree to within 0.033mm.
